## Purpose
The agents API: list (paged and sorted), get, create, update and delete, plus a list variant that includes guardrails.

## Responsibilities
`agentsApi`:
- list and withGuardrailList: `GET /api/agents` with parameters;
- get: `GET /api/agents/{id}`;
- create: `POST /api/agents`;
- update: `PATCH /api/agents/{id}`;
- remove: `DELETE /api/agents/{id}`.

## Key elements
